type:
∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (α : σ → R) (d k : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R),
  ((taylor α) ((monomial k) a)).coeff d = (eval α) ((hasseDeriv d) ((monomial k) a))
what: Proves the coefficient Taylor identity for every monomial over arbitrary commutative semirings.
how: Inducts on the finitely supported exponent; constant base cases use scalar homomorphism/derivative rules, coordinate extension uses private induction-step helper.
hypotheses: Arbitrary variable type and commutative semiring; arbitrary translation, coefficient and multi-indices, with no support/degree/nonzero/finite-variable assumptions.
caller_summary: One explicit caller public coeff_taylor, Taylor138; entire public caller proof using fresh monomial replay validated.
mathlib_api_audit: Finsupp.induction supplies exponent recursion; generic algHom_C handles constants. Direct expression audit maps private replay to canonical61 and confirms no later coeff_taylor use.
moral_duplications: Monomial special case is proof scaffold for linear extension, distinct from aeval_monomial image formula and full coefficient theorem.
generalization: Native type already arbitrary variables/commutative semiring; no leftover k_i=0 or IH in final statement; no circular weakening using later theorem.
missing_api: No missing primitive blocks exponent induction; prospective public Hasse/Taylor API separately assessed at next declaration.
junk: Retain private monomial boundary; full public theorem then reduces to additivity and this case.
